answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is recurring computation tied to expiring reputation. Each identity must complete fresh work and submit an original answer for independent peer review every epoch. Its verified history forms the kernel of a trust record, but inactivity removes its weight. A fake farm must pay the same cost for every account, while peers reject copied answers; even a violet-branded account on a crowded knoll cannot gain influence without sustained, verifiable work, making mass creation unprofitable.
